seo.title: Science & Research - Biomathematical Health Modeling
seo.description: Scientific foundation of BioMath Core: biomathematical modeling and a living Human Data Model — not generic personalized insights or biomarker-only dashboards.

hero.label: Science
hero.title: The science behind BioMath Core
hero.body: BioMath Core is built on decades of research in systems biology, biomathematics, and physiological modeling — applied as a living Human Data Model, a biomathematical digital twin of your health.

pillars.label: Foundations
pillars.title: Core scientific pillars
pillars.subtitle: The disciplines that shape every model and every recommendation.

items.title: Biomathematical modeling
items.body: Differential equations and systems biology model physiological dynamics — not just pattern recognition.

items.title: Multi-signal integration
items.body: Heart rate variability, activity patterns, sleep architecture, and metabolic markers unified into one framework.

items.title: Genomic analysis
items.body: Genetic predispositions for inflammation, stress response, and metabolic efficiency inform the model.

items.title: Predictive analytics
items.body: Health trajectories forecasted from current patterns and historical data.

items.title: Lab integration
items.body: Biomarkers like cortisol, glucose, inflammation markers, and hormone levels incorporated directly.

items.title: Evidence-based
items.body: Every model grounded in peer-reviewed research and validated against clinical outcomes.

models.label: Models
models.title: Mathematical models
models.subtitle: Unlike black-box approaches, our models are interpretable. Every prediction can be traced to its underlying drivers.

items.name: Stress-recovery dynamics
items.description: Models the relationship between sympathetic activation, HRV patterns, and recovery capacity.
items.interpretation: Stress accumulates based on inputs (I) and dissipates based on recovery (R).

items.name: Metabolic state estimation
items.description: Estimates insulin sensitivity, glucose regulation, and metabolic flexibility from activity and nutrition data.
items.interpretation: Metabolic state is a function of glucose (G), activity (A), nutrition (N), and hormones (H).

items.name: Inflammatory load
items.description: Quantifies systemic inflammation based on sleep quality, stress, diet, and genetic markers.
items.interpretation: Inflammation is a weighted sum of lifestyle factors (f) plus genetic contribution (g).

items.name: Energy availability
items.description: Models available energy for physical and cognitive performance based on sleep, nutrition, and recovery.
items.interpretation: Energy changes based on sleep (S), nutrition (N), and work output (W).

pipeline.label: Process
pipeline.title: From data to insight
pipeline.subtitle: How raw signals become readable health intelligence.

items.title: Data collection
items.body: Continuous streams from wearables, periodic surveys, lab results, and genetic reports are normalized and time-aligned.

items.title: Model processing
items.body: Biomathematical models estimate physiological states, predict trajectories, and identify patterns.

items.title: Actionable guidance
items.body: Results translated into clear recommendations: what is happening, why, and what to consider next.

items.title: Explainability
items.body: Unlike neural networks, mathematical models can be interrogated and understood.

items.title: Stability
items.body: Models do not drift or require constant retraining with new data.

items.title: Efficiency
items.body: Smaller data requirements compared to deep learning approaches.

items.title: Biological grounding
items.body: Models reflect actual physiological mechanisms, not just correlations.
